changelog:
- Initial release of the academic-literature-ppt skill.
- Converts academic papers and articles into professional literature review PPTX slides.
- Summarizes and translates original research content to Chinese, strictly preserving all citations, figures, tables, and statistical details.
- Ensures blue-themed academic slides, consistent font use (Microsoft YaHei), and precise adherence to provided style and structure contracts.
- Suitable for summarizing literature for presentations, journal clubs, paper reviews, or group meetings.
